description: Adding a table creates it and its view and trigger
output:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ledger_entry` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `amount` integer,
  CONSTRAINT `ledger_entry_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `ledger_entry_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `ledger_entry_owner_index` ON `ledger_entry` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `ledger_entry_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `ledger_entry`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `ledger_entry`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `ledger_entry_no_update`
BEFORE UPDATE ON `ledger_entry`
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_entry is append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `ledger_entry_no_delete`
BEFORE DELETE ON `ledger_entry`
FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ledger_entry is append-only'); END;

CREATE VIEW `ledger_entry_view` AS
SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`amount` AS `amount`
FROM `ledger_entry` AS `t`
